author: DiscussingFilm
text:
Kojima Productions has released a statement debunking the recent Bloomberg article surrounding ‘Physint’ moving to XBOX.

“The speculation surrounding our relationship with PlayStation, the commercial success of the ‘Death Stranding’ series, and the production plans or investments for ‘Physint’ — as well as any defamation — impacts not only our studio, but also our fans, creative partners, and all the individuals we have worked alongside for the past 30 years.

None of the content in these articles is based on official or verifiable documented sources. We kindly ask that you approach these articles and information with caution.

To reiterate clearly here: Our studio is in a healthy and profitable state; development of ‘Physint’ is progressing smoothly in collaboration with XBOX; and our relationship with PlayStation remains as strong as ever.”
